mechanics.rationale: Represent the described attempt as a completed flight only when Sam and the selected helicopter are at the same location. No represented state supports requirements about training, fuel, weather, or flight safety.

checks.label: Sam and the helicopter are at the same location
the selected helicopter is the one being attempted

limits: This records a flight as completed when the action is accepted; the represented state cannot distinguish an unsuccessful attempt from a successful one.
The mechanic does not model flight safety, training, fuel, weather, or destination.
tests: Sam and the helicopter share a location: the action increments Sam's completed flights by one.
Sam and the helicopter are at different locations: the action is refused and no flight is recorded.
A non-aircraft entity supplied as the helicopter is refused.
